info.title: MNBJYN Election Results API
info.description: Collects polling-unit results from the field app and serves live results to the Situation Room. All paths live under /api/v1. Send JSON with 'Content-Type: application/json' and (except public endpoints) 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.
